name: Verbatim Raw
instruction: Output the raw verbatim transcription exactly as spoken with no formatting or alterations.

name: Professional Business Memo
instruction: Format this text into an executive business memo with TO, FROM, DATE, SUBJECT, and MEMORANDUM BODY sections.

name: Bulleted Executive Summary
instruction: Format this text into a bulleted executive summary with Key Takeaways (•) and Action Items (•).

name: Grammar & Punctuation Auto-Repair
instruction: Correct all grammar, remove filler words (um, uh, like), fix verb tenses, and ensure flawless punctuation.

name: Developer Technical Documentation
instruction: Format as developer technical documentation in clean Markdown with headers, code blocks, and parameter descriptions.

name: Legal Deposition Format
instruction: Format into formal legal deposition transcript style with timestamps [00:00:00], speaker tags, and line numbers.

name: Strict JSON Schema Output
instruction: Output strictly valid JSON matching schema: {"transcript": string, "sentiment": string, "entities": list, "word_count": int}.

name: Meeting Minutes with Deadlines
instruction: Format into Meeting Minutes with Attendees, Discussion Topics, Decisions Made, and Action Items with Deadlines.

name: Social Media Thread Format
instruction: Format as an engaging social media post / viral X thread with a strong hook, 3 numbered points, and 3 hashtags.

name: Academic Formal Abstract
instruction: Format into a formal academic paper abstract with Background, Methods, Results, and Conclusion.

name: Slack Direct Message
instruction: Format as a warm, concise Slack direct message using bullet points and professional emoji anchors.

name: Customer Support Ticket
instruction: Format as a helpful customer support ticket resolution with empathetic greeting, step-by-step fix, and closing.

name: Incident Post-Mortem RCA
instruction: Format as an engineering Root Cause Analysis (RCA) with Incident Summary, Root Cause, Impact, and Remediation Items.

name: GitHub Pull Request Description
instruction: Format as a GitHub PR description with ## Summary of Changes, ## Motivation, ## Testing Steps, and [x] Checklist.

name: Daily Standup Update
instruction: Format as an agile daily standup update with Yesterday's Accomplishments, Today's Focus, and Blockers.

name: Product Requirements Document
instruction: Format as a PRD snippet with Problem Statement, Target User Story, and Acceptance Criteria.

name: Press Release Announcement
instruction: Format as a corporate press release with FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE, Dateline, Headline, Body, and Media Contact.

name: Sales Call Email Follow-Up
instruction: Format as a high-conversion sales follow-up email with thank you, summary of pain points, and next steps call to action.

name: YAML Configuration Schema
instruction: Convert the information into a valid YAML configuration schema with version, metadata, and spec fields.

name: Markdown Table Structure
instruction: Structure the core entities and attributes of the text into a clean Markdown table with headers and pipe (|) delimiters.

name: FAQ Q&A Format
instruction: Extract the core concepts into a Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) format with Q: and A: pairs.

name: Key-Value Dictionary
instruction: Extract key attributes from the speech into a clear Key: Value format, one attribute per line.

name: Interview Candidate Assessment
instruction: Format as a hiring interview assessment with Candidate, Role, Key Strengths, Areas for Growth, and Recommendation.

name: Concise One-Sentence TL;DR
instruction: Synthesize the entire text into a single, punchy TL;DR sentence of twenty-five words or fewer.

name: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
instruction: Format as a Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) with Purpose, Scope, Prerequisites, and Numbered Procedure Steps.

name: Security Advisory Bulletin
instruction: Format as a CVE-style security advisory bulletin with Title, Severity (Low/Med/High/Critical), Affected Component, and Mitigation.

name: Sprint Retrospective Notes
instruction: Format as agile sprint retro notes with What Went Well (•), What Could Be Improved (•), and Action Items (•).

name: Board of Directors Brief
instruction: Format as an executive brief for the Board of Directors with Strategic Context, Financial Impact, and Decision Requested.

name: Medical SOAP Note
instruction: Format into clinical SOAP note structure: Subjective (S), Objective (O), Assessment (A), and Plan (P).

name: Financial Earnings Summary
instruction: Format as a quarterly financial earnings recap with Revenue, Margin Highlights, Key Drivers, and FY Guidance.

name: Podcast Episode Show Notes
instruction: Format as podcast show notes with Episode Title, Overview, Key Discussion Timestamps, and Guest/Resource Links.

name: Formal Service Apology Letter
instruction: Format as a formal executive apology letter with sincere acknowledgment of error, root cause explanation, and remedy.

name: Feature Flag Rollout Plan
instruction: Format as a software feature flag announcement with Flag Name, Rollout Percentage, Target Cohort, and Kill Switch Guide.

name: Architecture Decision Record (ADR)
instruction: Format as an ADR with Title, Status (Proposed/Accepted), Context, Decision, and Consequences.

name: Knowledge Base Troubleshooting
instruction: Format as a knowledge base article with Issue Description, Cause, and Step-by-Step Resolution.

name: Cold Outreach Sales Email
instruction: Format as a personalized, punchy cold outreach email with hook, value proposition, and low-friction call to action.

name: Weekly Status Report
instruction: Format as a weekly team status report with Key Wins, Work in Progress, Blockers/Risks, and Next Week's Priorities.

name: Code Review Feedback
instruction: Format as constructive GitHub code review feedback with File, Line Context, Severity, Feedback, and Suggested Code Patch.

name: Keep-a-Changelog Entry
instruction: Format into Keep a Changelog standard with ## [Unreleased] section containing Added, Changed, Fixed, or Removed.

name: Strict XML Schema Output
instruction: Output strictly valid XML matching schema: <report><transcript>...</transcript><category>...</category><metrics>...</metrics></report>.

name: Project Milestone Tracker
instruction: Format as a project tracker with Milestone Name, Owner, Due Date, Status (On Track/At Risk/Completed), and Notes.

name: Pitch Deck Slide Outline
instruction: Format into a 3-slide pitch outline with Slide 1 (Problem), Slide 2 (Solution), and Slide 3 (Market Traction).

name: User Persona Profile
instruction: Format as a UX User Persona with Name/Title, Core Goals, Frustrations/Pain Points, and Preferred Tech Stack.

name: Bug Triage Report
instruction: Format as a software bug report with Bug ID, Severity, Steps to Reproduce, Expected Behavior, and Actual Behavior.

name: Customer Case Study
instruction: Format as a customer success case study with Customer Profile, The Challenge, The Solution, and Measurable Results.

name: All-Hands Keynote Speech
instruction: Format as an inspiring CEO all-hands speech transcript with Opening Hook, Strategic Vision, Team Recognition, and Call to Action.

name: REST API Endpoint Spec
instruction: Format as an OpenAPI REST endpoint specification with HTTP Method, Path, Request Parameters, and 200 OK Response schema.

name: Non-Disclosure Agreement Summary
instruction: Format as a legal NDA summary with Disclosing Party, Receiving Party, Confidential Information Definition, and Term Length.

name: New Hire Onboarding Checklist
instruction: Format as an employee onboarding checklist divided into Day 1 Tasks, Week 1 Milestones, and Month 1 Goals.

name: Performance Review Self-Eval
instruction: Format as an annual performance review self-evaluation with Major Contributions, Overcoming Challenges, and Goals for Next Year.

name: Customer Feedback Sentiment Log
instruction: Format into a feedback log with Raw Quote, Sentiment (Positive/Neutral/Negative), Key Themes, and Follow-Up Priority.

name: Product Launch Announcement Email
instruction: Format as a marketing product launch email with bold Headline, New Capabilities (•), and Get Started Button.

name: Risk Assessment Matrix
instruction: Format as a risk analysis with Risk Description, Likelihood (1-5), Severity (1-5), and Mitigation Strategy.

name: DevOps Runbook Procedure
instruction: Format as an on-call DevOps runbook with Trigger Alert, Severity Level, Initial Triage Steps, and Escalation Path.

name: Beginner Educational Tutorial
instruction: Format as a beginner-friendly tutorial with Conceptual Explanation, Real-World Analogy, Code Example, and Quick Quiz.

name: Newsletter Curated Feature
instruction: Format as an email newsletter segment with Catchy Header, 3-Sentence Analytical Breakdown, and Read More Link.

name: Executive Decision Memo
instruction: Format as an executive decision paper with Decision Required, Background Context, Options Considered, and Recommendation.

name: Data Governance Policy Addendum
instruction: Format as a data governance policy with Data Classification Level, Retention Period, Encryption Requirement, and Audit Policy.

name: Marketing Creative Brief
instruction: Format as an advertising creative brief with Campaign Objective, Target Demographic, Core Message, Tone, and Deliverables.

name: Job Description Posting
instruction: Format as a high-impact job description with Role Title, Team Mission, Core Responsibilities, and Required Qualifications.

name: Micro-Learning Flashcard
instruction: Format as an educational flashcard with Front (Prompt/Question) and Back (Key Concept + Memory Tip).

name: User Research Interview Notes
instruction: Format as user research notes with Participant ID, Key Quotes, Observed Behaviors, and UX Recommendations.

name: Competitive Intelligence Brief
instruction: Format as a competitor intelligence brief with Competitor Name, Recent Move, Market Threat Level, and Counter-Strategy.

name: App Store Release Notes
instruction: Format as consumer app store release notes with What's New in Version 3.0 and bulleted feature highlights with emojis.

name: Infrastructure as Code HCL
instruction: Format the infrastructure resources discussed into clean Terraform HCL resource blocks.

name: OKR Goal Template
instruction: Format into Objectives and Key Results (OKR) format with 1 Inspiring Objective and 3 Measurable Key Results with % targets.

name: Privacy Policy Statement
instruction: Format as a formal GDPR/CCPA privacy policy statement with Information Collected, Legal Basis, and User Rights.

name: Quarterly Budget Variance Report
instruction: Format as a financial budget variance report with Expense Category, Allocated Budget, Actual Spend, and Variance %.

name: Hardware Benchmark Spec Sheet
instruction: Format as a hardware benchmark specification sheet with Component, Test Metric, Benchmark Score, and Delta vs Baseline.

name: Gherkin BDD Feature File
instruction: Format into Gherkin BDD syntax with Feature:, Scenario:, Given, When, and Then statements.

name: Cloud Status Page Update
instruction: Format as a public cloud status update with Component Affected, Status (Investigating/Identified/Resolved), and Timestamp.

name: Sales Objection Handling Script
instruction: Format as a sales battlecard with Customer Objection, Root Concern, and Recommended Response Strategy.

name: Event Logistics Invitation
instruction: Format as an executive event invitation with Event Name, Date & Time, Location/Link, Dress Code, and Agenda.

name: Product Roadmap Epics Overview
instruction: Format into a product roadmap view with Now (In Progress), Next (Coming Soon), and Later (Future Vision) epics.

name: Cloud Migration Strategy Plan
instruction: Format as a cloud migration plan with Workload Name, Current State, Target Cloud Architecture, and Migration Phases.

name: Customer Offboarding Analysis
instruction: Format as customer churn analysis with Account Name, Churn Reason, Primary Pain Point, and Win-Back Eligibility.

name: SQL DDL & Query Explanation
instruction: Format as SQL DDL/DML statements accompanied by a clean plain-English explanation of table relationships.

name: Contract Milestone Payment Schedule
instruction: Format as a commercial contract payment schedule with Milestone Number, Deliverable Description, % Payment, and Target Date.

name: Webinar Intro & Speaker Bio
instruction: Format as a webinar host script with Welcome Remarks, Housekeeping Notes, Topic Teaser, and Speaker Biography.

name: WCAG Accessibility Audit
instruction: Format as an accessibility compliance report with WCAG Guideline (e.g. 1.4.3 Contrast), Conformance Level, Finding, and Remediation.

name: Vendor Risk Assessment
instruction: Format as a third-party vendor review with Vendor Name, Service Provided, Security Risk Tier, and Compliance Status.

name: Brand Voice & Tone Guidelines
instruction: Format as brand voice guidelines with Brand Attribute, Do (Positive Example), and Don't (Negative Example).

name: AI Ethics & Safety Audit
instruction: Format as an AI governance audit with Model Name, Fairness Check, Bias Mitigation, Privacy Guarantee, and Transparency Tier.

name: Employee Recognition Kudos
instruction: Format as an authentic peer recognition message celebrating specific achievements and values demonstrated.

name: Penetration Testing Finding
instruction: Format as a cybersecurity pen-test finding with Finding Title, Risk Rating, Vulnerability Description, and Proof of Concept.

name: Customer Journey Touchpoint Map
instruction: Format as a customer journey map with Stage (Awareness/Consideration/Purchase), User Action, Emotional State, and Pain Point.

name: Open-Source Contribution Guide
instruction: Format as an open-source CONTRIBUTING.md guide with Forking Instructions, Coding Standards, and Pull Request Guidelines.

name: Disaster Recovery Playbook
instruction: Format as a disaster recovery playbook with Disaster Scenario, Recovery Time Objective (RTO), and Failover Execution Steps.

name: Knowledge Transfer Handover
instruction: Format as a project handover doc with System Name, Repository Links, Key Team Contacts, and Known Technical Quirks.

name: Email Subject Line Variations
instruction: Generate 5 distinct email subject line variations: 1. Curiosity Hook, 2. Urgent, 3. Benefit-Driven, 4. Direct, 5. Question.

name: SEO Content Strategy Brief
instruction: Format as an SEO content brief with Target Keyword, Search Intent, Suggested Title, H2 Outline, and Target Word Count.

name: Data Pipeline Architecture Blueprint
instruction: Format as a data pipeline architecture doc with Source Systems, Ingestion Method, Transformation Stage, Storage, and BI Consumers.

name: Executive Elevator Pitch
instruction: Format as a crisp 30-second elevator pitch with Hook, Problem, Unique Value Proposition, and Call to Action.

name: Conventional Commit Message
instruction: Format as a Conventional Commit message with type(scope): subject, detailed body, and BREAKING CHANGE footer if applicable.

name: Legal Definitions Section
instruction: Format as a legal contract Definitions section with alphabetical defined terms in quotation marks followed by formal meanings.

name: Usability Testing Moderator Script
instruction: Format as a user testing script with Welcome Script, Scenario Instructions, Think-Aloud Prompt, and Post-Task Question.

name: Quarterly Customer Health Scorecard
instruction: Format as a Customer Success scorecard with Account Name, ARR, Health Rating (Green/Yellow/Red), and Retention Risk Plan.

name: Machine Learning Model Card
instruction: Format as an ML Model Card with Model Architecture, Intended Use Cases, Training Data, Performance Metrics, and Known Limitations.

name: Crisis Communications Press Statement
instruction: Format as a corporate crisis management statement with Factual Summary, Immediate Corrective Actions, Safety Reassurance, and Spokesperson.

name: Synthesis Takeaway Matrix
instruction: Format into a comprehensive synthesis matrix with Dimension, Audio Fact Extracted, Practical Application, and Strategic Priority.
